firstIdlePolicy: Server sets finishedAt now on the first idle report; repeated idle retains it; catching_up clears it and the next idle resets it
freshnessPolicy: Any missing or stale active Desktop report restricts Web fanout to the cumulative small allowance; no old initial-upload completion is used as current catchup evidence

webPolicy.readyAfter: UTC day after verified catchup completion

clientTriggerPolicy: Initial upload incomplete, prior-UTC legacy backlog, upload-budget or oversized hold, or conservative sum of pending credits above45000; routine same-day provider bursts do not alone trigger catchup
clientCompletionPolicy: Once triggered, retain catchup until the whole queue is empty and seed/recovery completes; resample on the existing pass, no fast telemetry poll
sequenceRecoveryPolicy: Persist reportSequence independently; on rejected older report use the authoritative response sequence to freshly resample on a later existing pass, never blindly replay old idle
